welcome.text: {name} was on its own for {time} and has news for you:

weather.rain: It rained {when}, so I sat under my umbrella and listened to the drops.
weather.rain_bare: It rained {when}, and I didn't mind one bit.
weather.rain_night: It rained in the night – I slept right through it.
weather.snow: It snowed {when}, and everything turned white.
weather.snow_night: It snowed in the night, and afterwards everything was white.

story.solo_ball: I played with my ball for a while.
story.solo_ball_more: I played with my ball again and again.
story.solo_tower: I built a little tower out of stones.
story.solo_drawing: I drew a picture in the ground.
story.solo_snowman: It was snowing, so I built a tiny snowman.
story.solo_skill: I went over to the training ground and trained {skill} all by myself.

fruit.berry: I picked a ripe berry and ate it right away.
fruit.cherry: I ate a giggle cherry and couldn't stop giggling.
fruit.herb: I ate a healing blossom and felt much better.

story.peek: {pet} peeked over the fence at me.
story.guest: {pet} came in from the garden, and now we're friends.
story.found: I found something in the grass and kept it for you: {thing}.
story.nest: My friend brought me an egg from its family and tucked it into a bed of moss for me to look after.
story.laid: I was so happy these last days – and this morning there was an egg of my very own in the moss!
story.wild_friend: I showed {pet} my tricks, and now we're friends.
story.wild_shrug: I showed {pet} my tricks, but {pet} wasn't impressed.
story.battle_win: {foe} wanted to scuffle, but I was stronger!
story.battle_lose: {foe} picked a fight with me, and this time I lost.
story.battle_draw: {foe} and I scuffled, but neither of us gave in.
story.battle_ball: {foe} ran after my ball instead of scuffling with me.
story.guardian: I got past {foe}, the guardian of the path!
story.unlock: Now I know a new way: {area}!

house.1: Now I have a hut of my own to sleep in!
house.2: My hut has grown into a cabin, with a window!
house.3: My cabin is a real house now!

story.find: On the way I found something: {item}.
story.trip_home: I came back home with a full backpack.
story.trip_tired: I got tired and turned back.
story.trip_beaten: I'd had enough and turned back.
story.trip_snack: I had a bite from my backpack on the way and felt better.

evolve.adult: I'm all grown up – now I'm a {species}!

Hello!
{name} stayed with me for a day. {did} Now it's back with you – it missed you!
Love, Grandma

grandma.garden: We pulled weeds in my garden and ate strawberries.
grandma.tea: We drank tea and looked at old photos.

story.magpie_stole: A magpie in a top hat swooped down and flew off with something of ours: {item}!
story.magpie_chased: A magpie in a top hat tried to steal something of ours ({item}), but I chased her off!
story.magpie_back: The magpie brought back what she took ({item}) and even bowed.
story.magpie_egg: The magpie has given up: she left her top hat behind, and there's an egg in it!

settings.pet_hint: Feed your pet and play with it:
settings.no_location: Weather: no location set yet (see Location below).
settings.location_hint: For the weather and for sunrise and sunset, in decimal degrees, such as 52.52 and 13.40. Any map app or OpenStreetMap shows them for a place. South and west are negative.
settings.update_running: Updating … the panel goes dark for a moment, and this page reloads by itself when it's done.
settings.update_failed: The last update failed. The log says why: journalctl -u led-matrix-update
settings.pet_save_hint: The pet and everyone in the album as a file, to keep them safe or to move them to another display.
settings.pet_save_confirm: Load the pet from {file}? {name} is replaced (and kept once on the Pi as pet.before-load.json).
settings.away_hint: Pets that live on a phone right now. If the phone is lost, you can fetch a pet back here; the copy on that phone stops counting then.
settings.fetch_back_confirm: Fetch {name} back without the phone? The copy on the phone stops counting then.

blob.0: A {child} that is petted many times a day, a whole week long, learns to purr. And it never stops again.
blob.1: Eight strokes every day, seven days in a row – and our little one began to purr. – M.
blob.2: My blob back then wanted to be stroked all the time. After a week of that it purred like a cat, and it grew up purring.

ember.0: Scratched into the rock: three glow berries for the little flame, and it grew into the fire itself.
ember.1: A {child} that eats glow berries from the cave burns brighter inside. Three are enough, they say.
ember.2: An old recipe, half burnt: …glow berries, three of them, while it is still small…

stone.0: Smudged ink on a pebble: wait for the full moon. A {child} that grows up in its light keeps it forever.
stone.1: A message in a bottle: our stone child grew up on a full-moon night, and the moon stayed in it.
stone.2: Stones listen to the moon, my dear. When it is round and bright at night, they change.

fox.0: Carved into a mushroom: little foxes that come here often enough take the forest's light home with them.
fox.1: I was a {child} once too. Four times I went to the mushroom forest, and its glow got into my tail.
fox.2: A scrap of a map, the mushroom forest circled four times. Next to it: for the little fox.

cloud.0: Frozen into the ice: a cloud that grows up in falling snow turns soft as wool.
cloud.1: Up on the mountain they wait for snowflakes before a {child} grows up. Nobody tells me why.
cloud.2: One winter a little cloud grew up while it was snowing – the fluffiest thing I ever saw. Snow in a globe works too, I hear.

leaf.0: Pinned to a tree: a sprout that eats from its own plant blossoms. Four fruits, and it is never just green again.
leaf.1: Pressed blossoms in an old tin, and a note: from the fruits it picked off its plant itself.
leaf.2: My sister was a {child}. She picked fruit after fruit off her own plant and grew up all in blossom.

duck.0: A soaked note by the water: three trips in the rain with the little duck. Now it wears a bubble.
duck.1: A message in a bottle: rain on the way is a duckling's best friend.
duck.2: A {child} that hikes through the rain often enough never gets wet again. My mother always said so.

hippo.0: On a wet leaf: tuck it in yourself, every evening. A {child} dreams of whoever does.
hippo.1: A message in a bottle: six evenings I tucked our little hippo in myself, and it grew up all dreamy.
hippo.2: Little hippos sleep best when somebody tucks them in. Not the light going out by itself – somebody.

beak.0: Torn from a logbook: even a {child} can get past a guardian. Past two, and it gets wings like no other.
beak.1: The bravest bird I know got past two guardians while it was still small.
beak.2: Grandpa's bird was a little daredevil. Before it was grown it had got past two guardians of the path.

caterpillar.0: A note on a blade of grass: giggle cherries, more than any other fruit, and it grew up laughing.
caterpillar.1: A {child} that likes giggle cherries best of all grows up a jester. Really!
caterpillar.2: A little box full of cherry stones. On the lid: all for the {child}, more than anything else.

dog.0: A {child} that danced at the trick festival grew up to be the greatest show dog of all.
dog.1: A crumpled festival programme: …and the little pup dances! The crowd went wild.
dog.2: Once a puppy danced at the festival before it was grown. It never stopped performing after that.

dragonfly.0: On a reed: when the sun comes out after the rain, the little ones grow rainbows.
dragonfly.1: A damp note: grew up the moment the sun came back after the rain. Wings like a prism!
dragonfly.2: Wait for a rainbow day, I always say. A {child} that grows up then shimmers in every color.

beaver.0: Carved into a stump: a {child} that grows up in a finished house becomes a master builder.
beaver.1: A waterlogged plan: hut, cabin, house. Only after the house did ours grow up.
beaver.2: An old folding ruler, and on it: the bigger the house, the bigger the dreams.

crab.0: Written in the sand: a crab that grows up beside a sandcastle wants one on its own back.
crab.1: A message in a bottle: set a sandcastle out for it. You'll see.
crab.2: My cousin was a {child}. A sandcastle stood in front of his house when he grew up – and look at him now!

axolotl.0: Scratched beside the guardian's spot: the little one beat Gloompeep. Something woke up in it.
axolotl.1: A message in a bottle: a {child} that wins against Gloompeep grows up a dragon.
axolotl.2: They aren't as soft as they look, those axolotls. One beat Gloompeep while it was still small.

mouse.0: In a mouse hole: grew up wearing Grandma's knitted hat, and now it's wool all over.
mouse.1: When a little mouse grows up wearing one of my hats, it never wants to take it off again.
mouse.2: That {child} grew up in a hat its grandma had knitted. Cosy, cosy!

bear.0: Carved into bark: a {child} that loves its people with all its heart grows up to the stars.
bear.1: Every heart of the bond, all five, and a little bear becomes a star bear. So the old ones say.
bear.2: A honey jar, and inside a note: five hearts full.

penguin.0: Frozen into the snow: just before sunrise the sky turns green. A {child} that grows up then keeps the color.
penguin.1: On the pier: get up early. The little one grew up at dawn and has shimmered ever since.
penguin.2: The most beautiful penguin I know grew up in the last minutes before the sun rose.

bat.0: Bat writing on the wall: full moon. Night. Then.
bat.1: A {child} that grows up under the full moon carries the moon on its wings.
bat.2: On full-moon nights the little bats circle my chimney. One of them grew up right there, silver all over.

owl.0: On a feather: three scuffles, not once on the ground. The little owl learned to move like a shadow.
owl.1: Scratched into a rock: a {child} that is never knocked over grows up a silent fighter.
owl.2: An owl from my attic scuffled three times while it was small and never fell over. Now it moves so quietly I never hear it.

chameleon.0: Under a leaf: the little one made two friends out here and copied them until it became a mirror.
chameleon.1: A {child} that makes two friends on its travels while it is small grows up looking like all of us.
chameleon.2: A shard of mirror wrapped in a note: for my two friends from the trips.

scarab.0: Chiselled into a warm stone: born of the heat. Only on the hottest days does the little roller become a king.
scarab.1: A papyrus scroll: when the air glows, the {child} grows golden.
scarab.2: Where I come from, a {child} waits for a scorching day to grow up. Then it wears the sun as a crown.

kite.0: Tied to a cairn: let it grow up in a thunderstorm. The lightning makes it fly forever.
kite.1: A kite string with a note: grew up on the night of the storm.
kite.2: A {child} that grows up while thunder rolls rides the storm from then on.

octopus.0: In a shell: the cleverest little one sank to the deep and came back wise.
octopus.1: A message in a bottle: train its head, not its arms. A clever {child} grows up mysterious.
octopus.2: The wisest octopus I know trained nothing but its wits as a child.

gargoyle.0: Scratched under the bell: at noon the bell rings. Whatever grows up then rings with it forever.
gargoyle.1: On a stone: the little guardian grew up at the stroke of twelve, in the middle of the day.
gargoyle.2: In my village the stone figures grew up at noon, when the church bell rang.

magpie.0: A festival ribbon, first place, and on the back: won by a {child}. It has done real magic ever since.
magpie.1: Winning the trick festival while still small – that's how a magpie becomes a magician.
magpie.2: A buried top hat with a note: for the little winner of the festival.
